metadata.title: WPA Global Institutions Master List
metadata.description: REV7 reconciles the user-supplied global diplomatic-academy/international-affairs control list against REV6, adds only resolved current entities, normalizes successor names without duplication, and retains unresolved historical cases in watchlist.

groups.H: Courts, Tribunals, International NGOs & Professional Associations (38 records)

protocol_relevance_levels.C: International organization / multilateral / NGO reference relevance (22 records)
protocol_relevance_levels.D: General reference / minimal direct protocol relevance (0 records)

metadata.verification_status: REV6 additions were reconciled individually against REV5 and relevant WPA benchmark layers. Wider legacy-record source verification remains in progress; URL presence alone does not equal source verification.
metadata.public_status: Pre-publication candidate / internal review. Not final public benchmark until wider source verification and institutional review are completed.
metadata.motto: „Преговарањето е опционално. Протоколот е апсолутен.“ / "Negotiation is optional. Protocol is absolute."
metadata.url_restoration_note: Seven records have no active website field: A005, A010, A035, B008, C011, D027 and H036. D027 is historical; H036 has independent corroboration but no resolved primary domain.

D026.restoration_reason: National Defense University occupied the pre-D001-repurpose slot in an earlier dataset generation and is restored without overwriting the now-canonical D001 record.

International Organization of Ceremonial and Protocol (OICP)
institutions.institution_type: International nonprofit ceremonial and protocol professional organization
institutions.verification_status: VERIFIED — primary source + independent institutional corroboration
institutions.notes: Founded 16 November 2001 in Palma de Mallorca, Spain. International non-profit organization advancing ceremonial and protocol, professional standards, research and international exchange; organizes the International Congress of Protocol and maintains specialized bodies including the International Academy of Ceremonial and Protocol (AICP) and the International Data Center. Primary source reviewed: https://www.oicp-protocolo.com/quienes-somos/ . Independent professional corroboration reviewed through the Asociación Española de Protocolo.
